note: 2024-05-15: As of 2022 data for NACE 70.100 (Activities of head offices) will be published. This is based upon new decision rules for classification of head offices with substantial operations abroad or with other Swedish enterprise units. These new decision rules have resulted in certain large head offices being reclassified as independent units and are to be published within NACE 70.100. These have previously been published together with the serviced activity or within NACE 70.220.
2024-05-15 For the year 2022, no data for NACE 4- and 5-digit level will be published.

2025-05-14: As of 2022 data for NACE 70.100 (Activities of head offices) will be published. This is based upon new decision rules for classification of head offices with substantial operations abroad or with other Swedish enterprise units. These new decision rules have resulted in certain large head offices being reclassified as independent units and are to be published within NACE 70.100. These have previously been published together with the serviced activity or within NACE 70.220. As of 2023 the decision rules were reviewed which can lead to changes in industrial classification for some enterprises.
2025-05-14: For the years 2022 and 2023, no data for 4- and 5-digit SNI will be published.
2025-05-14: Deflated variables are expressed in last years prices.
2026-02-18: Data concerning 2022 and 2023 have been revised.
2026-02-18: For the years 2022, 2023 and 2024 no data for 4- and 5-digit SNI will be published.
2026-02-18: Deflated variables are expressed in last years prices.
Correction 2026-03-06: Data for the years 2023 and 2024 has been corrected due to missing data for certain aggregates, no values have been changed.

2026-05-13: Data concerning 2023 and 2022 have been revised. With the implementation of PAYE (pay-as-you-earn) for employment and labour data, a new method for imputations has been implemented, where wages and salaries from PAYE are used in combination with employees to treat non-response. This new method has been implemented in the revised data sets for 2022 and 2023 as well as for 2024.
2026-05-13: For the year 2024, no data for 4- and 5-digit SNI will be published.
